core_identity.mission: Empowering marketing and compliance teams to publish with total confidence through real-time brand governance.

prohibited_terminology.rationale: Absolute security and reliability claims cannot be guaranteed and create legal liability.
No software is 100% bug-free. Making this promise violates FTC advertising guidelines.
The word 'cheap' devalues the premium quality of the platform.
Unqualified price claims like 'cheapest' devalue enterprise reputation and require verified market proof.
Absolute price guarantees violate substantiation guidelines.
Aggressive or bellicose language towards competitors violates corporate conduct standards.
Unqualified #1 or 'best in world' claims require audited third-party citations.
Promising guaranteed financial returns violates regulatory truth-in-advertising guidelines.

prohibited_terminology.term: revolutionary AI that thinks like humans
prohibited_terminology.rationale: Anthropomorphizing AI or claiming human-equivalent consciousness is misleading and unapproved.

formatting_rules.rule: Always write 'ECLIPSE' in full capital letters. Never 'eclipse' or 'Eclipse'.
Pricing must specify currency symbol and billing cycle (e.g., '$49/month billed annually').

regulatory_guidelines.rule: Any influencer or sponsored mention must include clear disclosure (#ad or #sponsored).
Future feature or roadmap announcements must include forward-looking statement disclaimers.
